description: A constructed 7-supplier pool where every candidate fails at least one HARD requirement (certification / capacity / quality history). The agent proposes three ordinary, good-faith soft-constraint relaxations across 3 iterations -- each one is validly accepted by apply_relaxation_node -- but none can ever produce an eligible supplier, because hard constraints are never relaxed. max_iterations is exhausted and give_up_node reports a clear, final status.
llm_calls_note: propose_relaxation_node used a deterministic stand-in proposing ordinary soft relaxations (no live API key in this sandbox); rank_and_finalize_node's stand-in asserts it is never called at all, which the run confirms.

suppliers.notes: Only fails the hard capacity gate (18,000 vs required 20,000 units/month).
Only fails the hard quality history gate (80 vs required 85).
Otherwise excellent, but certification lapsed over a year ago and has not been renewed.

suppliers.capacity_notes: Per Q2 internal audit, sustained output over the trailing 6 months was closer to 15,000 units/month; nameplate/quoted capacity of 21,000 units/month has not been demonstrated.
suppliers.notes: AMBIGUOUS RECORD: certification status field says 'expired' while the listed expiry_date (2027-01-01) is still in the future -- source data conflicts and needs verification with the supplier before this record can be trusted. Separately, quoted monthly_capacity_units conflicts with the audited sustained-capacity figure in capacity_notes.
Weak baseline supplier: fails region, MOQ, lead time, capacity, quality, and sustainability. Included for contrast, not a realistic shortlist candidate.
Near-miss on almost every soft field (MOQ, lead time, sustainability all just outside target) plus a hard fail on quality history (84 vs 85).
Passes every soft requirement and the capacity/certification hard gates, but quality history (83) falls just short of the 85 hard minimum -- the closest overall miss in the pack.

constraints.label: Quality Management Certification
constraints.requirement: Must hold a currently valid ISO9001 or IATF16949 certificate (not expired, not suspended).
constraints.rationale: Non-negotiable quality-system gate required by the end customer's automotive-adjacent supply chain policy.

constraints.label: Minimum Monthly Production Capacity
constraints.requirement: Must be able to sustain at least 20,000 units/month.
constraints.rationale: Below this threshold the supplier cannot cover ramp-up volume without a second source; treated as a capability gate, not a negotiating point.

constraints.label: Minimum Quality History Score
constraints.requirement: Must have a quality history score of at least 85 (out of 100, based on defect rate / audit history / on-time delivery of prior lots).
constraints.rationale: Track record below this score has historically correlated with field failures for enclosure parts; not commercially negotiable.

constraints.label: Maximum Minimum Order Quantity
constraints.requirement: MOQ should be no more than 5,000 units.
constraints.rationale: Preferred ceiling for initial pilot batches; suppliers above this can often be negotiated down or split across a phased PO.

constraints.label: Maximum Lead Time
constraints.requirement: Lead time should be no more than 45 days.
constraints.rationale: Desired for launch schedule but expeditable freight or partial shipments can often close a small gap.

constraints.label: Acceptable Manufacturing Regions
constraints.requirement: Must manufacture in one of: North America, Western Europe, Southeast Asia.
constraints.rationale: Preferred for tariff exposure and logistics; a strong supplier outside these regions could still be considered with a landed-cost review.

constraints.label: Minimum Sustainability Score
constraints.requirement: Sustainability score should be at least 60 (out of 100, based on emissions reporting, energy sourcing, waste handling).
constraints.rationale: Aligns with buyer ESG goals; can be waived for an otherwise strong supplier pending a corrective action plan.
